name: ApiKey

test_list.description: Resolve one SDK secret location once and retain only a secrecy-wrapped API credential.
Missing credentials and provider permission failures have distinct typed errors; no implicit fallback.
Empty or header-control-bearing credentials are rejected without reflecting the secret.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Explicit production or fixture provider selected by the composition root.

output_description: Validated opaque credential or sanitized typed source/missing/invalid failure.
